# Deploying `uc-docs`

Generated by `trestle env render`; re-render to update. Follow the steps in order. A step's script
runs from anywhere and is safe to re-run. The services, their routes and addresses are in
[LAYOUT.md](LAYOUT.md).

## Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    n0(["<b>Clients</b>"]):::clients
    n1{{"<b>Envoy</b><br/>gateway"}}:::gateway
    n2["<b>Unity Catalog</b><br/>data catalog"]:::component
    n0 -->|":8080"| n1
    n1 -->|"/api/2.1/unity-catalog, /unity-catalog"| n2
    classDef clients fill:#f1f5f9,stroke:#64748b
    classDef gateway fill:#ede9fe,stroke:#7c3aed
    classDef component fill:#eff6ff,stroke:#2563eb
    classDef external fill:#fafafa,stroke:#737373,stroke-dasharray: 4 3
```

## Start

### 1. Start the stack

Start every service and wait until each one is healthy:

```bash
docker compose up -d --wait
```

The gateway then serves the stack at <http://localhost:8080>. [LAYOUT.md](LAYOUT.md) lists every route and address.
